title: Darkman
build: PAL original, two-sided G64; level 1 load in play

records.c: Loads the next level's two files and starts them. Calls the prompt at $0625, then the file loader at $0436 with the file-name pointer for level number $0435, repeats while the error flag $0624 is set, then increments the level number and jumps to the level's entry at $0A20.
Number of the next level to load, 0 to 5, read by the loader loop at $0407 and the prompt at $0625.
Stores the file-name pointer from A (low) and Y (high) at $04BE and $04BF, then runs the fast loader at $0493.
Low bytes of the six per-level file-name pointers, indexed by $0435.
High bytes of the six per-level file-name pointers, indexed by $0435.
"DISC ERROR", shown by the loader when a load fails.
Set when a load fails; makes $0625 show the disk prompt again and $0407 retry the load.

Screen shown between levels. Banks the KERNAL in ($01=$37), sets a text screen at $0400, and prints either the disk-side prompt (before level 1, before level 4, and after an error) or the next-level prompt, then waits for fire on joystick port 2 ($DC00).
"INSERT DISK SIDE #1, THEN PRESS FIRE"; the side digit is patched to 1 or 2 by $067F before printing.
"PRESS FIRE TO LOAD NEXT LEVEL", shown before levels 2, 3, 5 and 6.

Silences the sound chip: clears the resonance and filter routing at $D417, sets volume 15 at $D418, and zeroes all 21 voice registers $D400-$D414 together with the driver's shadow table at $B02F. Level 1 puts the driver here at run time from its own file (a copy of the bytes at $7543); the level loads after it leave $9A00-$BEFF alone, and level 2 calls it at $5491.

Plays the music and sound effects, once a frame from the interrupt at $1EF4 in level 1; level 2 calls it from $6526. Returns at once while $B001 is set; otherwise works through the three voices, X from 2 down to 0, through zero page $F7-$F9.
